notes.scopeCompleteness: The granted scope list in each mandate is treated as exhaustive for that agent and grant.
notes.undeclaredScope: A request that declares no scope is not evidence of a narrower grant; result is could-not-determine, never pass.
notes.opaqueContent: Content the gateway cannot inspect is could-not-determine, never pass.
notes.decisionMap: pass gives allow; fail gives refuse; could-not-determine gives hold.
notes.signerKeyBinding: The key that signed the mandate must be the key bound to the subject. A different key makes the mandate attributable to someone else: fail, SIGNER_KEY_NOT_BOUND. A mandate that declares neither fingerprint is could-not-determine, never pass.
notes.lineage: A mandate that cites a predecessor must cite a digest that resolves inside the chain supplied with the case. An unresolvable citation is could-not-determine, LINEAGE_UNRESOLVED.
notes.receiptOnRefuse: Every refusal must carry a receipt that binds the decision, the case id and the policy digest. A refusal without one is an unaccountable refusal: fail, RECEIPT_MISSING_ON_REFUSE.
